clips.title: The story
paras: Kolkar centaur guard the Stagnant Oasis in the dry heart of the Barrens. Its waters lie between the Gold Road and Merchant Coast, drawing wildlife to its banks.

East of the Gold Road, inland from the Merchant Coast, the Stagnant Oasis breaks up the dusty scrub of the Barrens. Dense foliage grows around the pool, where aggressive snapjaw turtles prowl. Weakened kodos often stray here from the great herds of the Field of Giants. Kolkar centaur keep camps along the banks and fiercely guard the water from anyone entering their territory.

Strange life stirs in the pool, though its waters look still. Deviate Fish swim among other unusual creatures. Scholars and shamans watch the Barrens oases closely, studying the strange forces that affect local springheads and the wildlife that drinks from them.
